description: Granite foundation: a wide GRNT slab with supporting GRNT piers.
name: granite_foundation
why: GRNT (density 2700 kg/m3, k=2.8 W/mK, begins melting ~1215-1260 C, resists every acid except HF) is a non-conductive, high-mass footing -- unlike RCNC it carries no electrical path, so it is the safe generic choice for a foundation slab sitting directly under conductive plant (STEL frames, CU busbars) without ever creating a floor-wide short (see the conductive_floor_span lint rule).
